instruction: Candid photographic still, medium shot. Inside a gym with hanging straps and yellow walls, the man in the white t-shirt and orange beanie (R1) stands on the left, facing right and laughing. Opposite him, the blonde woman in the lavender hoodie (R2) stands on the right, facing left and laughing heartily. The man points his right hand towards the blonde woman, while their other hands gently touch and interlock fingers at waist level. In the far bottom-left background, a highly blurred bystander is partially visible. The scene is lit by bright overhead lights with a warm yellow background.
elements: R1 points his right hand toward R2
R2 is the person being pointed at by R1
R1 points while his other hand interlocks fingers with R2 at waist level
R1 and R2 gently touch and interlock fingers at waist level
R1 and R2 face each other and laugh during the contact
gym setting with hanging straps and yellow walls
